FN-L5494WY-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 282
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Economic Development
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/17/2026
Senate Bill 282 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund by $15, and the
Alabama Housing Foundation by $5, for application for certificate of title for manufactured
homes designated 1999 or prior.
In addition, this bill could also increase receipts to the appropriate issuing official by up to $3
for each application processed.

FN-L5494WY-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 282
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/27/2026
Senate Bill 282 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to the State General Fund by $15,
and the Alabama Housing Foundation by $5, beginning January 1, 2027, for application for each
certificate of title for manufactured homes designated 1999 or prior.
In addition, this bill could also increase receipts to the appropriate issuing official by up to $3
for each application processed.
